generic: Hyo hyo! Look what the fish dragged in! A tasteless cretin!
You've returned? Have you come to appreciate my beautiful pots?
Your... it's as ugly as I remember. An offense to my artist's eye!
low_health_comeback: How dare you touch my magnificent body! I will turn you into the most grotesque piece in my collection for that!
You uncultured swine! You chipped my pot! Unforgivable!
overkill: Your death was not even artistic. Just a dull, pathetic end.
I am an artist. You are merely raw material.
